global_constraints.description: Per-P order parameter constraints for LiPON glass

metadata.notes: PO3N is the N-substituted tetrahedral environment that gives LiPON its ionic conductivity. F_IS distinguishes PO4 from PO3N. v6 constraints for EnvironmentConstrainedOptimizer with adaptive penalties.

environment_types.PO3N: N-substituted tetrahedral (n_O=3, n_N=1) - key LiPON feature
